idea: Body parts (Friday school readiness, long 2:30 learning song) in JIMMY'S ROOM: a shiny rainbow soap bubble lands right on Baby Jimmy's nose ('Pop! Oh, wow! A bubble on my nose!'); chorus 'Nose and ears, tummy and toes! Touch them, touch them, here we go!'; each verse starts with a surprise bubble landing on the next body part – nose (boop, sniff sniff), ears (listen), tummy (pat pat pat), toes (wiggle wiggle); clap break (copy-me claps); review 'Nose! Ears! Tummy! Toes!' and the question 'Where is your nose? Hmm?' (2 s pause) – 'There it is! Boop! Yay!'; lesson: I know my body – nose, ears, tummy, toes. Loop: the hook framing again, bubble on his nose, bye-bye wave.
title: Bubble on My Nose! 👃 Body Parts Song with Baby Jimmy | Nursery Rhymes & Kids Songs | Crayon Babies
description:
Pop! A shiny soap bubble lands right on Baby Jimmy's nose! 👃 Sing along with Baby Jimmy in his cozy bedroom and learn four body parts – nose, ears, tummy and toes – as the bubbles pop on each one.

🎬 What happens in this video:
😮 "Pop! Oh, wow! A bubble on my nose!"
👃 Nose – boop, boop, boop! Sniff, sniff, sniff!
👂 Ears – touch your ears and listen!
🤗 Tummy – pat your tummy with Jimmy! Pat, pat, pat!
🦶 Toes – wiggle your ten little toes!
👏 Clap break – clap, clap, clap your hands with Jimmy!
🤔 "Where is your nose?" – can you find it?
👋 Bye bye, friends!

📚 Kids learn: body parts • nose • ears • tummy • toes • English words: touch, listen, pat, wiggle, clap

🎵 Lyrics (chorus):
Nose and ears, tummy and toes!
Touch them, touch them, here we go!
Nose and ears, tummy and toes!
Boop, boop, boop! My little nose!

A fun sing-along body parts song for toddlers and preschoolers – point, touch, pat and wiggle along with Baby Jimmy to learn your nose, ears, tummy and toes. A cappella children's song with voices, claps and a hand drum.
